$comment: The kinds of filesystem an engine home may not be on (E36 item 7, which settles E32 item 2; D1 §6.1). A kind is named as /proc/self/mountinfo names the filesystem type of a mount; a type with a subtype (`fuse.sshfs`) is of the kind before the dot. `refused` lists the names the tests pin, each with the class that makes it unsafe; the engine may refuse more names of the same three classes. Any other kind starts normally, `accepted` and a name nobody has heard of included: the engine cannot check that storage honours a sync, and does not pretend to. Tests read expectations from this file, never from the engine.
